content: Tita ka'itiyakame meyeitɨa tewi
Merikɨtsɨ 'auriena mekaniyukuxeɨrieni paritseutsixi meta hipatɨta 'inɨarikɨ memɨte'ɨkitametetɨkai Kerutsareme memeyekɨnekai,
mekaniwaruxeiya teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama hipatɨ metekwakame wamamá ka'itiyakaku mekamaimatɨkaitɨ huriyutsixi wayeiyari kemɨ'ane. Mekaniniukixiekaitɨni mɨkɨ.
(Paritseutsixi meta hipatɨ huriyutsixi teɨteriyari yunaitɨ, xɨka kwinimieme meka'utimaimani, tixaɨtɨ mepɨkatekwaka, yututsima wayeiyaritsie yametekahutɨ.
Tetuayamete wakiita retinaneme, pɨkatikwaka katihauxinietɨkaime. Waɨkawata mɨiretɨ yeiyari kanixuaweni yamemɨtekahunikɨ, tekɨxite, xarite, katsute kememɨte'itie).
Hikɨ paritseutsixi meta 'inɨarikɨ te'ɨkitamete mɨpaɨ mekatenita'iwawiya: —¿Titayari yututsima wayeiyaritsie yamekatekahu 'ahetsɨa miemete teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete, wamamate ka'itiyatɨkaikaku metekwa'a?
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: —Kitsariyaxi 'aixɨa putayɨ tihekɨatatɨ xeme xehepaɨtsita, xemɨte'itawa, mɨpaɨ katine'uka:

content.text: tita memɨte'ɨkita, teɨteri wa'aitsika pɨhɨkɨ xeikɨa”.

content: Tita mɨti'aitakai Kakaɨyari xete'uhayewaka, teɨteri wayeiyaritsie xeteniwiyani, tekɨxite harewemete kexemɨtehauxina, tawarita hepaɨna mɨireme kexemɨteyurie».
Mɨpaɨta katiniwarutahɨawe: —Xeme xeikɨa yuyeiyaritsie yaxetekahutɨ xekanakɨne, xe'ihayewaka tita Kakaɨyari mɨti'aita.
Muitsexi mɨpaɨ kanainekaitɨni: “Yaketinekamieni kememaitɨka 'apaapa meta 'amaama”. Tawarita mɨpaɨ kanaineni: “Kemɨ'ane 'axamutaineni yupaapa meta yumaama wahepaɨtsita, ke'umierieni”.
Xemetsɨ pɨta mɨpaɨ xekateni'ɨkitani: “Tewi pɨyɨwe mɨpaɨ mɨtikɨhɨaweni yupaapa yatɨni yumaama, nepiini naime kɨmana nemɨmatsiparewienikeyu, mɨkɨ kuruwani kanihɨkɨtɨni” (nepimini Kakaɨyari manuyɨne).
'Ana mɨkɨ waɨriyarika pɨkapitɨarie 'atsimɨtiyurienikɨ yupaapa yatɨni yumaama hetsiemieme.
Xekaneyeitɨani Kakaɨyari niukieya, yaxetekahutɨ yuyeiyaritsie, xemɨyukuxaxatɨwa. Waɨkawamekɨ xepɨteyurie 'ikɨ hepaɨ.
Tawarita yu'aurie waruta'inieka teɨteri, mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Xekeneneu'eni yunaitɨ, meta xeketenemaiwaweni:
Tewi 'aurie tixaɨtɨ pɨkatixuawe hetsiena heutahame mɨyɨwe ka'itiyakame meyeitɨani. Tita taɨtana mɨratineika, mɨkɨ pɨta kanihɨkɨtɨni tewi ka'itiyakame mayeitɨwa.
Xewitɨnetɨ mu'enaxɨ ke'u'ena.
Hikɨ teɨteri waruku'eirieku, kiita heutahaku, teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama mekanita'iwawiya 'ɨxatsi hepaɨtsita kemɨti'ɨkitakai.
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —¿Kari xemeta 'atsixepɨkatemaiwawe wahepaɨ? ¿Xeme mɨpaɨ xekatehetimaiwe, naitɨ tewi 'aurie mɨtixuawe hetsiena heutahame pɨkayɨwe ka'itiyakame meyeitɨani?
'Iyarieyatsie mɨkaheutahakekɨ, yuriepana pɨta kaneukahakeni, 'ariketa kanihɨamɨkɨ. Mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ, naime 'ikwai 'itiyakame kanixatakaitɨni.
Tawarita mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Tita tewi taɨta mɨratineika, mɨkɨ pɨta kanihɨkɨtɨni tita ka'itiyakame meyeitɨa.
Karikɨ teɨteri wa'iyaritsie katinimiemetɨni, 'axa'iyaritɨarika, kememɨteyukumaɨwa teɨteri kemɨkatiheitserie,

'inawari, xeime kemɨtiumieni, xeime kemɨtiukumayɨani kayɨ'ɨya kayɨkɨna, katiyupini mɨtihiwe'erie, 'axakememɨteyurie, 'irɨmari, kememɨteyukahiwe'erie merukuyatɨwetɨ, kememɨteyukwatsirie, 'axaniuki hipame wahepaɨtsita, kememɨteyukatawe'erie meta yakɨ xeikɨa kememɨteyɨkɨhɨawe.
Mɨkɨ naitɨ 'axamɨti'ane, wataɨta katinimiemetɨni, meta tewi ka'itiyakame kanayeitɨwani.
Yuri kemɨti'eriekai 'ukaratsi tsirupenitsiyatanaka
Hikɨ mana yeyaka, Tiru kwieyaritsie kaneyani.
Mana kiita kaneutahani, xewitɨ tɨma pɨka'imariekakekai pɨra'eriwakai Ketsutsi, peru pɨkayɨwekai mana mɨyuhayewakɨ kamariwatɨ.
Merikɨtsɨ, 'ukaratsi kaniu'ena hepaɨtsitana, kakaɨyari mɨka'itiya kaninɨkaitɨni mɨkɨ nu'aya 'ukatɨme, hikɨ 'ukaratsi kwitɨwa hetsɨana nuaka, hɨxiena kaniutihɨximakeni.
Mɨkɨ 'ukaratsi kanikɨriyekutɨkaitɨni, Tsirupenitsiyatsie kaninuiwametɨkaitɨni, waɨriyarika kanipitɨakaitɨni meyenɨ'anikɨ kakaɨyari 'axamɨ'ane mixɨnakɨ niweya.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Kaneuyeweka tɨɨri meri memɨtihuxanikɨ, 'aixɨa pɨka'ane xɨka yuniwema paa warunawairieni, tsɨikɨri pɨta xɨka warumini.
'Ukaratsi mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Yuri peputaine Ti'aitame, peru 'atsita tsɨikɨri mepitikwa'a tɨɨri memɨtekuhayeikawa mexatɨa mɨkawiwiwe temɨxikiyari.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —'Aixɨa pemutayɨkɨ, kenemieri 'aixɨa 'iyari, kamɨ kakaɨyari 'axamɨ'ane 'ari kanixɨna 'aniwe.
Hikɨ yukie heta'aka kanitaxeiya yuniwe 'utatsie kakaime, kakaɨyari 'axamɨ'ane 'ixɨnaku.
Ketsutsi kemɨrenayehɨa tewi mɨkaheu'enakai mɨnenuriekai
Hikɨ Tiru kwieyaritsie heyeyaka Tsiruni kwieyaritsie kaneuyeyune. Tamamata Kiekarite mɨrakutewatsie 'uyeyaka, Karereya harakunayaritsie kaneta'ani.
Mana mekani'atɨirieni tewi mɨkaheu'enakai mɨnenuriekai, waɨriyarika mekanipitɨani hetsiena mutimenikɨ.
Yatewa heiwitɨka yɨxaɨtame teɨteri memɨka'anu'uwatsie, nakatana yu'itɨwame kaneuka'uitɨani, meta 'uta'aɨtsikawieka nenieya kaniumayɨani.
Yuheima heutiniereka Ketsutsi kaniuka'ietɨyani, yuniukikɨ mɨpaɨ tewi katiniutahɨawe: «'Epata» (taniukikɨ kewatiyepietɨkani panuyɨne).
Yapauka yunakata kaniwatiyepierixɨani meta nenieya kaniuxɨnarieni, heitseriemekɨ 'utaniutɨ kanayani.
Hikɨ kaniwaruhɨritɨani xeime memɨkatehekuxaxatɨwanikɨ, peru kemɨtiwaruhɨritɨa, mɨme matsi yemekɨ mekatenikuxatakaitɨni naitsarie.
Waɨkawamekɨ mekanihɨxiyakaitɨni teɨteri yame'utiyuatɨ: «Naime 'aixɨa katiniuyurieni, mɨkɨ memɨkaheu'enanakai meheu'enanakame kaniwarayeitɨwani, mɨkɨ memɨkaniuwawekai meniuwaweme kaniwarayeitɨwani».
